title: Prefix Aggregate
summary: Precompute cumulative state once so a fixed range can be answered by combining two boundary states instead of rescanning the range.
recognition_signals: many queries ask about ranges of one stable sequence
the range aggregate can be derived from two cumulative boundaries
the underlying sequence does not change between queries
core_rules: Use one explicit boundary convention consistently, such as prefix[i] representing values before index i.
A half-open range [l, r) is derived from the cumulative state at r and l.
structural_steps: build cumulative state from left to right
answer each range from its two boundaries

common_confusions.distinction: Prefix aggregate answers fixed range queries from two known boundaries. Prefix-state counting looks up earlier cumulative states while scanning to discover ranges that satisfy a target relation.
A prefix aggregate precomputes cumulative boundaries. A variable window maintains one active range and changes both boundaries incrementally.
